content: Valɨvaŋga tembene thɨ wovaŋgiva
E mbaŋako iyako Josuwa kaero i amalaghɨsarɨ moli. Amba Giya Loi i dagewe, iŋa, “Kaero u amalaghɨsarɨ moli, ko iyemaeŋge thelau laghɨye mbe inawe ma mba hu wo.
“Valɨvaŋgake thiyake amba ma hu wo: Pilistiya le ghamba mbaroko laghɨye na Gesu le ghamba mbaroŋgi,

iri e Walaghɨta Saihorɨ Ijipt valɨvaŋga e boimako, i wa e ghaiwabuko na ve wo Ekron gha teghala, iye Kenan le ghamba mbaro. Pilistiya gha kiŋɨke theghelima thiya yaku e ghembaghembake thiyake: Gaja, Asɨdod, Eskelon, Gat na Ekron, na vavanava iyaŋgaiye Avi lenji ghamba mbaro.
Valɨvaŋga e yaghalako, Kenani lenji valɨvaŋgako laghɨye, iri Mera, Saidon lenji valɨvaŋgako ve wo Apek, Amori ghanji teghala.
Gebal lenji valɨvaŋgako laghɨye; Lebenon laghɨyeko valɨvaŋga e boimako, iri Baalgad Ou Hemon raberabe na ve wo Lebo Hamat.

“Tembe ŋgoreiyeva Saidon gharɨgharɨniye lenji ghamba mbaroko laghɨye, iya thiya yaku e bobokuluko vanautumaniye, Lebenon Ououniye na Misrepot Maim e ghanji lughawoghawo. Ghino ne ya vagege raŋgiyaŋgi gharɨgharɨke thiyake na Isirel gharɨgharɨniye thɨ raka ru e ghamba mbaroko thiyako. U renuwaŋakiki na u tagaviyaviya thelauke iyake na u giya weŋgiya Isirel gharɨgharɨniye na lenji ghamba yakuyaku ŋgora va ya utuma e ghen.
Koino! Mbaŋake u tagaviyaviya thelauke na u giya weŋgiya uu theghesiwona na Manase gha uu vaŋgothiye.”
Thelau Jorɨdan valɨvaŋga i vorovoro gha tagaviyaviya
Uu Manase vaŋgothiye, uu Rubin na uu Gad kaerova thɨ wo lenji ghamba yakuyaku. Mosese, iye Giya Loi le rakakaiwo, va i wogiya weŋgi Jorɨdan valɨvaŋga e boimako.
Lenji ghamba yakuyakuko ve wo Aroerɨ, Anoni gunuguniye le ghambaghadɨ na ghemba ina e gunuguko iyako gha lughawoghawo na malamoko laghɨye iri Medeba na ve wo Dibon.
I wa ve wo vara Amon le valɨvaŋga ghaghadi, na i mbanɨvao ghembaghemba Kiŋ Saihon va i mbaroŋaŋgi, iye Amori lenji kiŋ mbaŋa va i yaku Hesbon e tɨne na i mbarowe.
Vambe i wova Giliyad, Gesu na Maka lenji valɨvaŋga. Ou Hemon le valɨvaŋgako laghɨye na Basan le valɨvaŋgako laghɨye ghaghadi Saleka.
Na tembe ve wova Kiŋ Og le ghamba mbaroko laghɨye, iye wabwi Repa moumouniye na va i mbaro Astarot na Edrei e tɨnenji. Mosese va i kivwalaŋgiya gharɨgharɨke thiyake na i vagege raŋgiyaŋgi.
Ko iyemaeŋge Isirel gharɨgharɨniye mava thɨ vagege raŋgiyaŋgiya Gesu na Maka gharɨgharɨniye; thiye mbe inanji Isirel e tɨnenji noroke.

Ko iyemaeŋge Mosese mava i wogiya thelau regha weŋgiya Livai le wabwi. Ŋgoreiya Giya Loi va le utuutu weya Mosese, thiye lenji yakuyaku kaiwae va i mena weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ lenji vowo mbaŋa thɨ bigirawe na thɨ ŋambu na i vorowe Giya Isirel lenji Loi.
Mosese va i giya uu na uu lenji ghamba yakuyaku uu Rubin e tɨne
Mosese va i giya ghamba yakuyakuke iyake weŋgiya uu na uu, uu Rubin e tɨne:
Lenji ghamba yakuyakuko va ve wo Aroerɨ, Anoni Gunuguniye gha teghala, na ghemba reghava ina e gunuguko gha lughawoghawo, na tembe ve wova malomaloŋako laghɨye i vaghɨliya Medeba.
Hesbon tembe i ruva weiyaŋgiya ghembaghembako wolaghɨye e malamoko: Dibon, Bamot Baal, Bet Baalmiyon,
Jahas, Kedemot, Mepat,
Kiriyataim, Sibma, Jeret Saha ina e bobokulu regha, e gunuguko tɨne,
Betɨpeo, Ou Pisga maloŋaloŋaniyeŋgi, na Bet Jesimot.

I wo ghembaghembako wolaghɨye e malamoko na Amori lenji kiŋ, Saihon le ghamba mbaroko laghɨye, iye va i mbaro Hesbon e tɨne. Mosese va i kivwala, tembe ŋgoreiyeva Midiya gha rambarombaroke wolaghɨye thiyeke: Evi, Rekem, Ju, Hu, na Reba. Thiyeke iyake va thɨ mbaroŋa valɨvaŋgako iyako Kiŋ Saihon kaiwae.
Weiyaŋgiya gharɨgharɨke thiyake, Balaam Beor nariye iye manɨyeto, Isirel gharɨgharɨniye vambe thɨ unɨghɨva.
Jorɨdan yalasiniyeko i tabo na uu Rubin lenji ghamba yakuyaku na ghanji teghala. Ghembaghemba nanasiye na laghɨlaghɨye va thɨ giya weŋgiya Rubin le wabwi, uu na uu lenji ghamba yakuyaku.
Mosese va i giya wabwi na wabwi lenji ghamba yakuyaku uu Gad e tɨne
Mosese va i giya ghamba yakuyakuke iyake weŋgiya wabwi na wabwi, uu Gad e tɨne:
Lenji ghamba yakuyakuko, Jaje na ghembaghembako laghɨlaghɨye wolaghɨye Giliyad e tɨne, na Amon lenji thelau vaŋgothiye na ve wo Aroerɨ, Raba boimaniyeko.
Lenji ghamba yakuyaku iri Hesbon ve wo Ramat Mijɨpa na Betonim, iri Mahanaim na ve wo Deba gha ghadɨko.

Jorɨdan Malamoniye e tɨne i wo Bet Haram, Bet Nimra, Sukot na Japon, Kiŋ Saihon le ghamba mbaro va i yaku Hesbon. Walaghɨtae Jorɨdan e yalasiniyeko iye ghanji teghala, na e ghaiwabuko ve wo Njighɨ Galili.
Ghembaghemba laghɨlaghɨye na nanasiyeke thiyake va thɨ giya weŋgiya wabwi na wabwi, uu Gad e tɨne na lenji ghamba yakuyaku.
Mosese va i giya uu na uu lenji ghamba yakuyaku wabwi Manase e tɨne
Mosese va i wogiya thelauko iyako valɨvaŋga weŋgiya wabwi na wabwi, uu Manase vaŋgothiye na lenji ghamba yakuyaku.

Thelauko iyako iri Mahanaim na i wo e ghaiwabuko. I wo Basan laghɨyeko na tembe ŋgoreiyeva ghembaghemba nanasiye ghembaewona, iyava mbaŋa regha Jai i kivwalaŋgi na i wo valɨvaŋgako iyako. Va mbaŋa regha Kiŋ Og, Basan e tɨne i mbaroŋa iya valɨvaŋgako iyako.

Va i wo Giliyad vaŋgothiye regha na tembe ŋgoreiyeva Astarot na Edrei. Ghembaghembake thiyake Kiŋ Og va i yaku Basan le ghamba mbaroko ghembaghembaniye laghɨlaghɨye. Iya valɨvaŋgako iyako va i wogiya weya uu Maki, iye Manase nariye.
Mosese va i giya thelauko iyako ŋgoreiye varako Jeriko na Jorɨdan valɨvaŋga i vorovoro mbaŋa va ina Mowab e malamoniye.
Ko iyemaeŋge Mosese mava i wogiya mun thelau regha weŋgiya Livai le wabwi. Va iŋa, lenji yakuyaku kaiwae ne i mena weŋgiya Isirel gharɨgharɨniye mbaŋa ne thɨ vakatha vowo weya Giya Loi.
